Name: Anime Marnie HD
Author: EldritchDame
Description:
This is a small, simple portrait mod, so if it’s not your style, feel free to skip it. And thank you to anyone who decides to use it. 
[quote]To install, place the file in [code]Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits[/code] and select it in-game using Portraiture. When you talk to Marnie, press [b]P[/b] until you see [b]Anime Marnie HD[/b], and her portrait will appear. [/quote]
